name: Glaive Tossing increases Warden's Blade's range by 20 yds (#1080)
contract: Glaive Tossing 680737 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE), EffectBasePoints 19 with DieSides 1 -> +20 yards, EffectSpellClassMask (word0 0, word1 0x4000000, word2 0x100). Warden's Blade ranks 1-6 (805508, 806812-806816) carry SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x4000000, so the mask selects them; their RangeIndex is 7, and SpellRange.dbc row 7 has RangeMax 10 for both hostile and friendly. The tooltip is 'Increases the range of Warden's Blade by 20 yds.'. Native consumers: SpellInfo::GetMaxRange calls Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_RANGE) and Spell::CheckRange (Spell.cpp:7201) does the same at cast time. The spell_max_range metric returns SpellInfo::GetMaxRange(positive, player); the Starcaller-specific 50-yard override in that function needs aura 801975 and a DmgClass of ranged, neither present on these fixtures. Expected: 10 on the control, 30 (+20) with the talent. The mask's word2 0x100 also matches Cosmic Trap 807195; that side effect is out of the issue's scope (see the class-tree-1 report) and not asserted.
